messages:
rachael: Hi team, onboarding hiccup. I completed Okta SSO but when I try to enroll MFA it errors: 'Device not compliant with policy'. I'm on a company Macbook enrolled in Jamf. Anyone seen this?

it-help: Hey @rachael, that message usually means the device hasn't reported the expected Jamf enrollment attribute to Okta. Can you confirm Jamf shows your device as 'Managed' and that the Jamf agent version is recent?

rachael: Jamf shows Managed and I have the MDM profile. Device Serial: C02X12345ABC. Jamf agent 2.1.0. Is there a required minimum?

it-help: We require Jamf agent >=2.2.0 for the conditional access assertion. Try updating Jamf binary: `brew upgrade jamf` or run the company enrollment helper. I'll queue a remote command to check device check-in.

devops-bot: remote-command: check-jamf-checkin for C02X12345ABC queued (cmd id: rc-812).

security: Also confirm you didn't enable Private Relay in iCloud — that can block Okta device signals. If you have it on, temporarily disable during enrollment.

rachael: I had Private Relay on. Disabled it and re-ran enrollment flow. Now Okta accepts the device but the 1Password invite says my account already exists and I can't claim it. I never completed setup.

1password-bot: Account claim status: existing account detected for rachael@redwood.com. If you previously started setup, use the browser signin flow to finish and locate the Secret Key under "My Account". Admin can also deprovision and resend an invite if needed.

rachael: I don't see "My Account" because the UI shows a temporary guest banner. @it-help can you check if I was issued a guest instead of a full account?

it-help: Checking... you were added as 'guest' by mistake. Fixed — switched to full user and resent the 1Password activation link. You should get a new email.

devops-bot: jamf-checkin rc-812: device reported agent version 2.3.1, last check-in 120s ago.

rachael: Got the 1Password activation, finished setup and CLI signin worked after I copied the Secret Key. MFA and device policy are all green now. Thanks for the fast help.

security: Thanks for the tip about Private Relay — we'll add that to the onboarding wiki note alongside Jamf version checks.

rachael: Happy to add a small checklist PR. One last question: I want to add my YubiKey for SSH access later — do we require PIV or OpenPGP?

it-help: We standardize on PIV for repo SSH and on OpenPGP for git commit signing. Docs in the handbook show both flows; ping me when you're ready and we'll whitelist your GitHub key once you register the public key.

rachael: Perfect, thanks everyone!
